name: PyPI JSON API
tagline: Package metadata and release data for Python packages on the Python Package Index
description: Public JSON endpoints that expose package metadata, project details, and release information from the Python Package Index (pypi.org). Used by package managers, CI tooling, and developers to look up package versions, dependencies, and project metadata without scraping the web UI.

auth.details: No authentication required for public package metadata endpoints

use_cases: look up latest version of a Python package
list available release versions for a package
check download URLs and file hashes for a release
